card.title: I Learned It the Hard Way
card.instruction: Treat experience with the system as seniority. Teach its shortcuts, warn against its traps, and remind everyone that your mistakes came first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't ask the committee why the roof leaks. Ask which meeting owns the leak.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I asked why. They made me chair of causes.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They've already asked me to investigate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Ask for your predecessor's report. That's mine. It took six meetings to learn how to request a ladder.

mechanism: A redirects a roof question through committee jurisdiction and offers a report earned by A's earlier procedural mistakes.
confusable: Unlike imposing bureaucracy for its own sake, A is teaching survival within a system through experience that confers seniority.
comparison: The leak alternative converts an unwanted investigation into use of a prior report; the permit alternative turns successive failed visits into warnings.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
